import os, pathlib, sys
from datetime import datetime
import ffml
clone = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FFML_REHEARSAL_CLONE']).resolve()
where = pathlib.Path(ffml.__file__).resolve()
assert clone in where.parents, f'ffml imported from {where}, not from the clone {clone}'
import ffml.eval.livetest_score as LS
assert clone in pathlib.Path(LS.__file__).resolve().parents
now = os.environ.get('FFML_REHEARSAL_NOW')
if now:
    LS.utcnow = lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(now)
print(f'REHEARSAL ffml from {where}; clock {now or "real"}', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

import os, pathlib, sys
from datetime import datetime
import ffml
clone = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FFML_REHEARSAL_CLONE']).resolve()
where = pathlib.Path(ffml.__file__).resolve()
assert clone in where.parents, f'ffml imported from {where}, not from the clone {clone}'
import ffml.eval.livetest_score as LS
assert clone in pathlib.Path(LS.__file__).resolve().parents
now = os.environ.get('FFML_REHEARSAL_NOW')
if now:
    LS.utcnow = lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(now)
print(f'REHEARSAL ffml from {where}; clock {now or "real"}', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

import os, pathlib, sys
from datetime import datetime
import ffml
clone = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FFML_REHEARSAL_CLONE']).resolve()
where = pathlib.Path(ffml.__file__).resolve()
assert clone in where.parents, f'ffml imported from {where}, not from the clone {clone}'
import ffml.eval.livetest_score as LS
assert clone in pathlib.Path(LS.__file__).resolve().parents
now = os.environ.get('FFML_REHEARSAL_NOW')
if now:
    LS.utcnow = lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(now)
print(f'REHEARSAL ffml from {where}; clock {now or "real"}', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

import os, pathlib, sys
from datetime import datetime
import ffml
clone = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FFML_REHEARSAL_CLONE']).resolve()
where = pathlib.Path(ffml.__file__).resolve()
assert clone in where.parents, f'ffml imported from {where}, not from the clone {clone}'
import ffml.eval.livetest_score as LS
assert clone in pathlib.Path(LS.__file__).resolve().parents
now = os.environ.get('FFML_REHEARSAL_NOW')
if now:
    LS.utcnow = lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(now)
print(f'REHEARSAL ffml from {where}; clock {now or "real"}', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

import os, pathlib, sys
from datetime import datetime
import ffml
clone = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FFML_REHEARSAL_CLONE']).resolve()
where = pathlib.Path(ffml.__file__).resolve()
assert clone in where.parents, f'ffml imported from {where}, not from the clone {clone}'
import ffml.eval.livetest_score as LS
assert clone in pathlib.Path(LS.__file__).resolve().parents
now = os.environ.get('FFML_REHEARSAL_NOW')
if now:
    LS.utcnow = lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(now)
print(f'REHEARSAL ffml from {where}; clock {now or "real"}', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

import os, pathlib, sys
from datetime import datetime
import ffml
clone = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FFML_REHEARSAL_CLONE']).resolve()
where = pathlib.Path(ffml.__file__).resolve()
assert clone in where.parents, f'ffml imported from {where}, not from the clone {clone}'
import ffml.eval.livetest_score as LS
assert clone in pathlib.Path(LS.__file__).resolve().parents
now = os.environ.get('FFML_REHEARSAL_NOW')
if now:
    LS.utcnow = lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(now)
print(f'REHEARSAL ffml from {where}; clock {now or "real"}', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

import os, pathlib, sys
from datetime import datetime
import ffml
clone = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FFML_REHEARSAL_CLONE']).resolve()
where = pathlib.Path(ffml.__file__).resolve()
assert clone in where.parents, f'ffml imported from {where}, not from the clone {clone}'
import ffml.eval.livetest_score as LS
assert clone in pathlib.Path(LS.__file__).resolve().parents
now = os.environ.get('FFML_REHEARSAL_NOW')
if now:
    LS.utcnow = lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(now)
print(f'REHEARSAL ffml from {where}; clock {now or "real"}', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))

import os, pathlib, sys
from datetime import datetime
import ffml
clone = pathlib.Path(os.environ['FFML_REHEARSAL_CLONE']).resolve()
where = pathlib.Path(ffml.__file__).resolve()
assert clone in where.parents, f'ffml imported from {where}, not from the clone {clone}'
import ffml.eval.livetest_score as LS
assert clone in pathlib.Path(LS.__file__).resolve().parents
now = os.environ.get('FFML_REHEARSAL_NOW')
if now:
    LS.utcnow = lambda: datetime.fromisoformat(now)
print(f'REHEARSAL ffml from {where}; clock {now or "real"}', file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(LS.main(sys.argv[1:]))
